title: Boundaries of Bondage: Slavery and Enslaveability in VOC Ceylon
scope: VOC Ceylon ordinances, caste labour, mobility/marriage controls and cinnamon-peeler obligations; cites Hovy's Ceylonees Plakkaatboek
limitations: Hovy is mediated through a modern scholarly chapter for the cited 1661 cinnamon-peeler marriage restriction; consult the Plakkaatboek directly before primary-source quotation.

title: How modern Sri Lankan plantations began
scope: Falck's 1769 cinnamon seed cultivation at Grandpass, compulsory Salagama labour, late-VOC cinnamon plantation expansion, early British coffee experiments and transition toward Kandyan highlands
limitations: High-value local synthesis rather than peer-reviewed scholarship; precise acreage and administrative details require corroboration before confidence A.

title: Plantation Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: Gill Juleff / University of Exeter Taking Tea project
scope: British opening of Kandyan highlands after 1815, road building, coffee estate expansion around Kandy, and coffee infrastructure as foundation for tea
limitations: Institutional research synthesis with cited bibliography; not a direct land-register comparison of individual former cinnamon gardens and coffee deeds.

title: Ceylonees Plakkaatboek: plakkaten en andere wetten uitgevaardigd door het Nederlandse bestuur op Ceylon, 1638–1796
scope: Edited corpus of VOC Ceylon ordinances; target for seed-export-ban and labour-control validation
limitations: Not consulted in extenso in RUN44. Specific cinnamon seed/plant export prohibition was not located through the secondary literature searched; absence must not be converted into proof that no such instrument exists.
